title: story doctor reports 15 relation-integrity violations across SH-31..SH-40

description:
WHAT: 'story doctor' reports 15 integrity violations in this project's own .storyhook data — missing inverse relations and stories with multiple parents. Exit is non-zero, so doctor cannot currently be used as a clean gate.

WHERE: stories SH-31 through SH-40. Full output:
  SH-31: missing inverse relation `child-of` on story `SH-34`
  SH-31: missing inverse relation `child-of` on story `SH-35`
  SH-31: missing inverse relation `child-of` on story `SH-36`
  SH-32: missing inverse relation `blocked-by` on story `SH-34`
  SH-32: story has multiple parents
  SH-33: missing inverse relation `blocked-by` on story `SH-34`
  SH-33: story has multiple parents
  SH-34: story has multiple parents
  SH-35: story has multiple parents
  SH-36: story has multiple parents
  SH-37: missing inverse relation `blocks` on story `SH-35`
  SH-37: missing inverse relation `blocks` on story `SH-36`
  SH-40: missing inverse relation `child-of` on story `SH-31`
  SH-40: missing inverse relation `child-of` on story `SH-32`
  SH-40: missing inverse relation `child-of` on story `SH-33`

WHEN: observed 2026-07-27 on main at 6c3e2da, immediately after a fast-forward reconcile. Pre-existing — NOT introduced by that merge; the affected stories date from earlier work.

EXTENT: two distinct failure classes, likely two distinct root causes:
1. Missing inverse relations (10 of 15) — 'story relate a rel b' appears not to have written, or later lost, the reciprocal edge on the target story. Suspect either a write path that only persists one side, or a rewrite path that drops relations it does not recognise.
2. 'story has multiple parents' (5 of 15) — either the parent-of relation lacks a single-parent constraint at write time, or multiple parents are legitimate and the doctor check is wrong. Decide which before repairing.

INVESTIGATION NOTES (do this before fixing):
- Reproduce the ORIGIN, not just the symptom: replay how SH-31..SH-40 were created (likely 'story decompose' from a spec, given the contiguous ID block) and see whether decompose emits one-sided relations. If so, that is the defect class and the repair of existing data is only half the fix.
- 'story doctor --fix' exists but has not been run; do not run it until the origin is understood, or the evidence is destroyed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Root cause identified for BOTH classes, with a failing automated test per class.
- Write path fixed so new relations cannot become one-sided (prefer making the invalid state unrepresentable at the storage layer).
- Existing SH-31..SH-40 data repaired.
- 'story doctor' exits clean on this repo, and a test asserts that.

text: [git] b60db32: chore(storyhook): file SH-59 and SH-60, two defects found reconciling main

Narrowing datum (2026-07-27, main @ f8645a0): 'story relate SH-61 blocks SH-58' wrote BOTH sides correctly — SH-58 shows the 'blocked-by SH-61' inverse. So the current 'story relate' write path is not the culprit. The missing inverses on SH-31..SH-40 came from some other origin: most likely 'story decompose' (those IDs are a contiguous block, consistent with bulk creation from a spec), or a since-fixed older version. Start the investigation at decompose's relation-writing code, not at relate.
